notes: Synthetic node lists of 0..5 nodes (kind byte matching 70% of the time) sharing two target records. Kinds are 0xf, 0x10 and 0x11 only: for other kinds the original passes a stale stack byte as the slot kind. The callees log their register inputs (AL/DL masked for 0xcc1ac) and stack arguments, pop them like the originals (0xbdd64 ret 0x14, 0xbe59c ret 0x2c) and return the next dword of a shared queue.
